theorems.statement: ∀ (Q n : ℕ) (Φ : Eucl n → Eucl Q) (Ω : Set (Eucl n)), IsOpen Ω → ContDiff ℝ 1 Φ → (∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ w ∈ Ω, ∀ w' ∈ Ω, c * ‖w - w'‖ ≤ ‖Φ w - Φ w'‖) → ∀ h : Eucl Q → ℝ, Continuous h → HasCompactSupport h → ∫ x in Φ '' Ω, h x ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl Q)) = ∫ v in Ω, Real.sqrt (Matrix.of fun i j : Fin n => inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ Φ v (EuclideanSpace.single i 1)) (fderiv ℝ Φ v (EuclideanSpace.single j 1))).det * h (Φ v)
